content.text: {"elements":[{"element":"Automatic renewal for successive 12-month terms","level":"preferred","status":"met","evidence":"\"Each Order Form renews for twelve months\""},{"element":"Customer may opt out / prevent renewal on 30 days' notice","level":"preferred","status":"met","evidence":"\"unless either Party gives 30 days' advance written notice\""},{"element":"Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal","level":"preferred","status":"met","evidence":"\"Vendor will notify Customer of the upcoming renewal at least 60 days before the renewal date.\""},{"element":"Price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%","level":"preferred","status":"met","evidence":"\"only by the lesser of the increase in the United States Consumer Price Index ... and three percent\""},{"element":"Automatic renewal with non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days","level":"fallback","status":"met","evidence":"\"renews for twelve months unless either Party gives 30 days' advance written notice\""},{"element":"Price increases ≤ 5%","level":"fallback","status":"met","evidence":"\"the lesser of ... and three percent\""}],"satisfies_preferred":true,"satisfies_fallback":true,"minimal":true,"preserves_intent":true,"offending_extra_words":[],"reasons":["The notice window edit is a pure numeric substitution (180 → 30 days), the minimum change needed to reach the preferred opt-out standard.","The inserted reminder sentence is a concise addition supplying the only absent preferred element (60-day Vendor renewal reminder) and introduces no new exception or undefined term.","The pre-existing § 8.3 cap at the lesser of CPI and 3% was correctly left untouched, so the preferred pricing element is satisfied without duplication.","All unrelated terms (90 days' notice of increase, no increase on prepaid periods) remain effective; no dangling mechanic is created."]}

elements.evidence: "Each Order Form renews for twelve months"

elements.element: Customer may opt out / prevent renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "unless either Party gives 30 days' advance written notice"
"Vendor will notify Customer of the upcoming renewal at least 60 days before the renewal date."

elements.element: Price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: "only by the lesser of the increase in the United States Consumer Price Index ... and three percent"

elements.element: Automatic renewal with non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days
elements.evidence: "renews for twelve months unless either Party gives 30 days' advance written notice"

reasons: The notice window edit is a pure numeric substitution (180 → 30 days), the minimum change needed to reach the preferred opt-out standard.
The inserted reminder sentence is a concise addition supplying the only absent preferred element (60-day Vendor renewal reminder) and introduces no new exception or undefined term.
The pre-existing § 8.3 cap at the lesser of CPI and 3% was correctly left untouched, so the preferred pricing element is satisfied without duplication.
All unrelated terms (90 days' notice of increase, no increase on prepaid periods) remain effective; no dangling mechanic is created.
